title: Budget-matched pooling of search and imitation candidates
hypothesis: A shared rollout selector exploits complementary search and imitation trajectories across structures better than spending the same probe budget entirely on either optimizer.

prediction.against: Both equal-budget search-only and imitation-only selectors on the same frozen structures
prediction.rationale: Requiring five points against both controls distinguishes complementarity from merely doubling the candidate budget; D-005 compared optimizers separately rather than pooling them. Requires per-idea GPU approval; stop the remote box afterward.

protocol.command: python scripts/stage_f.py pooled-optimizer --config config/stage_f/stage_f.yaml --additional-source logs/baseline_gpt61_sol_high --search-seed 2910 --fit-seed 2911 --probe-seed 2912 --heldout-seed 2913 --out-dir logs/research/pooled_optimizer_s2910
code_changes: scripts/stage_f.py (pooled-optimizer: 4 frozen subjects, 29 cached candidates per structure, three selectors of 15 under one tie rule, Bonferroni 97.5% intervals with Holm p-values)

falsified_by: An upper paired confidence bound below +0.05 against either control refutes the stated margin. Zero-spanning intervals are inconclusive, and tied success is not improvement. Positive evidence requires multiplicity-adjusted paired lower bounds above zero against both controls.

controls.note: controls are the equal-budget search-only and imitation-only selectors on the same subjects, probe and confirmation cases; the metric is already pooled minus the weaker comparison

result.notes: Four frozen subjects (anchors baseline61_gen0_cand2_a1 and gen0_cand1_a0; additional gen0_cand0_a0 and gen0_cand3_a0 by the frozen rule), 15 candidates per selector on probe s2912, confirmation s2913 (50). Pooled minus search-only -0.055, 97.5% [-0.110, +0.000], Holm p 0.053; pooled minus imitation-only +0.000 [-0.033, +0.033]. Upper bound against search-only is below +0.05: refuted, and the point estimate is negative. The search-only gain is one structure: on cand2_a1 the control's G6 draw (not in the pooled subset G1-G4) reached 0.56 while the pooled pick G4 (probe-best of its subset) scored 0.02, so search success there depends on drawing the right region. On cand1_a0 imitation dominates (pooled fit250 0.34, imitation-only fit312 0.38, search 0.00). The two additional subjects stay near zero under every selector (<= 0.04). Implementation: local/global draws from separate SeedSequence streams so pooled L1-L3/G1-G4 equal the control's; fit seed 2911 also seeds the demonstration split; 29 cached unique candidates per structure; 1710 episodes (1160 probe + 550 confirmation), 0 LLM calls.

verdicts.reasoning: Pooled minus search-only is -0.055 with 97.5% [-0.110, +0.000]; the upper bound is below the predicted +0.05, which refutes the margin (and the prediction needed gains against both controls). Against imitation-only the pooled selector ties (+0.000 [-0.033, +0.033]). Complementarity does not show up at equal budget: on cand2_a1 everything rests on hitting one good global region (search-only's 6th global draw), which halving the global draws in the pooled set misses; on cand1_a0 imitation already wins; the two additional weak structures stay near zero under all selectors, so neither optimizer rescues them.
verdicts.next_experiment: Weak zero-shot evolved structures are mostly not rescuable by parameter optimisation at this budget; prefer structural improvements that are known to work (geometry-scope mutation, D-006) and test their transfer (R-012) rather than optimiser mixing.

verdicts.reasoning: Both named equal-budget controls were measured [logs/research/pooled_optimizer_s2910/summary.json]. Both upper bounds fall below the predicted +0.05 margin, satisfying the predeclared refutation criterion [logs/research/pooled_optimizer_s2910/summary.json].
